Since Trump started his illegal war with Iran, Americans have paid $8.4 billion more at the gas pump.

Each American family has also shelled out an additional $1,700 to pay for Trump’s chaotic, illegal tariffs.

American families are footing the bill for Trump’s reckless policies.

Tax Day is rapidly approaching. Here’s 4 ways Trump’s made tax filing worse:

He cut one-fourth of IRS staff last year.
He keeps firing IRS leadership. 
He canceled Direct File.
His Republican cronies have cut the budget for investigations into wealthy and corporate tax cheats.

The Trump administration is effectively ‘disappearing’ people on U.S. soil.

ICE is not providing accurate information on where people are detained.

Some people aren’t tracked for weeks. Some locations are wrong. Some people are deported before locations are put in the system.

I’m pushing for accountability.

A wealth tax on the top .15% of the richest families would generate $6.2 trillion in revenue.

That could pay for:

Universal childcare
Millions of new homes
Slashing child poverty
Medicare for people aged 55+
Universal paid family leave
Tuition-free community college
And more.

The Trump administration has deported hundreds of people, including children, long-time U.S. residents, and those without criminal records to countries they are not from and without due process—even after courts ruled that this is illegal.

I’m pushing for an investigation.
nytimes.com/2026/04/10/busin…

$4 a gallon for gas. Increased airline baggage fees. An 8% surcharge for sending packages with the USPS. New fees on Amazon orders.  

The American people are paying the price for Trump's war with Iran.

We can't ignore that the President of the United States threatened to commit war crimes in our names.

Congress must vote to stop Trump’s war.

Trump’s administration prefers to focus on putting his signature on paper money.

Not ending his war in Iran.

Not lowering housing, health care, or child care costs.

And certainly not making life more affordable for American families.

NEWS: The DNC passed a resolution to denounce dark money in Democratic primaries.

It’s an important step in the fight to get big money out of politics.

We’re already seen AIPAC, crypto and AI industries flood our elections with millions in obscure ads—and we must push back.

The Trump administration’s latest attempt to dismantle the Education Department is moving student loans to the Treasury Department.

This illegal scheme threatens to trap borrowers, students, and families in chaos—while taxpayers foot the bill. I’m fighting to stop it.

Trump is threatening mass death in Iran if he doesn’t get his way. He has spiraled out of control—and Congress has the power to stop him and end this war.

Every Republican lawmaker who refuses to speak out, ducks a question, or votes to continue this war bears responsibility.

Trump is threatening war crimes to annihilate "a whole civilization".

Republicans in Congress repeatedly voted for Trump’s war and still won't do their job to end this madness.

Enough. Bring Congress back into session.

Republicans must grow a spine and stop this catastrophe.
If anyone looked right beneath the surface, they’d be able to see that Red Lobster’s real downfall was not offering endless shrimp — it was private equity’s endless greed.

Trump wants to increase military spending to over $1 trillion to fund his war in Iran—the highest level in modern history.

How will he pay for it? By gutting health care, housing, climate, and education programs, and making life harder for families.

None of this puts America first.

nytimes.com/2026/04/03/us/po…

Trump could appoint two more Supreme Court justices—cementing a Court that could threaten our rights and favor billionaires over everyone else for decades to come.

It’s time to ring the alarm bell and push back by holding Trump and Congressional Republicans accountable in the midterm elections.

nytimes.com/2026/04/03/us/po…

Is the U.S. military trying to use AI tools to spy on Americans or build killer robots?

I’m pushing for answers.

Video

Don’t forget: Pete Hegseth’s broker tried to buy millions of dollars in defense stocks before the Iran war began.

It’s absolutely appalling, and I’m pressing for answers.

The American people deserve leaders they can trust to put national security ahead of their personal financial profit.

THIS could cause "economic destruction."

Hate Ticketmaster?
